title: Space Opera: The Hollow Fleet
description: Your freighter drops out of hyperspace into the path of the Hollow Fleet — the armada that glassed your homeworld. One escape pod, one working ship, and a broadcast: 'Survivor, we know you're there.'

n1.caption: Your freighter's sensors scream — the Hollow Fleet, the armada that glassed your homeworld, fills the viewport. One escape pod left. And a broadcast on every channel: 'Survivor, we know you're there.'

n2a.caption: The channel opens to the face from your nightmares — the Admiral herself. 'We didn't destroy your world,' she says calmly. 'Your government did. We have the recordings.'

n2b.caption: The pod punches through the debris field — and you see it: your 'destroyed' homeworld glowing intact on the horizon, hidden behind a continent-sized holographic shroud.

n3a.caption: She uploads the recording: your world's leaders signing the glassing order — a staged attack to unite the colonies into a war they wanted. The fleet wasn't hunting you. It was hunting the truth.

n3b.caption: You cut the channel — and in the silence, your nav computer quietly deletes a hidden file titled EVIDENCE_DO_NOT_OPEN. Someone put it there. Someone you trusted.

n3c.caption: You descend through the shroud onto living streets — cities lit, people walking — and on every public screen, your own face, captioned: 'the traitor who sold us to the fleet.'

n3d.caption: The jump gate spins open — and out of it pour hundreds of freighters identical to yours, each broadcasting in your own voice: 'Survivor, we know you're there.'
